create.name: Amanda Johnson
create.bio:
Amanda Johnson is the founder of Awaken Village Press and the “book doula” of the spiritual publishing world — a woman whose own journey to authorship became the seed of an entire village. Writing her memoir taught her the truth she now builds her life around: stories are not birthed alone. They need community, care, and courage. From that knowing she created Awaken Village Press, the regenerative indie publishing house whose mission is to awaken the planet one book at a time, where she serves — in the Village’s own lovely language — as its Sun: tending the vision, holding the spark, and walking beside new authors from first word to published book.

Her own book, Becoming Free: From Letting Go to Embracing It All (2024), is the Village’s founding testament — one woman’s quest to unshackle herself from everything she fears, carried from the valleys of Peru to the beaches of Costa Rica to the piazzas of Italy, and written with the raw honesty, vulnerability and wisdom she now midwifes in others. For every reader who senses a book inside them, and for every seeker learning what letting go actually means, Amanda is living proof of her own teaching: that revealing and expressing more of who we truly are can change the world.

books.title: Becoming Enough: A Heroine’s Journey to the Already Perfect Self
books.author: Amanda Johnson
books.description: Amanda’s honest memoir about putting down the shield of judgment and ego, and living from the wholeness that was there all along. She traces the moments when well-meaning parents and mentors planted seeds of not-enoughness, then shares the breakthroughs that freed her. It’s a warm companion for anyone ready to stop striving and trust that who they already are is enough.

books.title: Becoming Free: From Letting Go to Embracing It All
books.author: Amanda Johnson
books.description: One woman’s journey to free herself from everything she fears, from the valleys of Peru to the beaches of Costa Rica and the piazzas of Italy. Amanda finds that non-attachment isn’t what we think: freedom isn’t in “having” or “not having” but in embracing all of it with an open heart. It’s a moving read for anyone who feels stuck despite having “let go” of everything.

courses.title: Voice of Eden (Author Incubator)
courses.description: A 12-week guided writing programme for people who sense a book or idea forming but don’t yet know its shape. Each week you publish one short, exploratory piece and respond to other writers’ work, and most participants finish with around 20,000 words. No prior writing experience is needed.

courses.title: Authors’ Village Membership
courses.description: A nurturing community for authors at every stage, from first idea to published book. Members get monthly live Zoom gatherings, guest sessions with authors and experts, writing prompts and a private WhatsApp community. They also receive a book from the press’s library every quarter and 10% off select offerings.
